run_tabular_training: run tabular data training with autotrain using a specified model and dataset path
register_tabular_subcommand: register the tabular subcommand parser with train deploy and inference arguments
create_tabular_command: create a RunAutoTrainTabularCommand instance from parsed CLI arguments for tabular training
validate_tabular_args: validate required tabular training arguments like project name data path and model
run_tabular_project: run an autotrain tabular project by creating params and starting the training job
